requirement: A targeted check must check only the requested requirement and must fail if that requirement does not exist.
justification: Scenarios: known selected requirement succeeds while another lacks evidence; full check fails; unknown selection fails rather than passing zero checks. run filters discovered requirements then rejects an empty selection, and subprocess tests assert those different statuses. Validated with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml (20 tests passing). Each cited test uses isolated fixture files and asserts outcomes, not merely the presence of instructions. Revalidated known/unknown IDs, other missing evidence and broken build isolation: filtering precedes validation, unknown IDs fail, and targeted checks skip build_skill. Existing filter tests plus the new broken-project test pass. All 21 checker tests passed with cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path language-lab-ci/Cargo.toml. Packaging revalidation: CLI implementation and behavior tests were relocated unchanged into the root crate and rerun successfully. The distribution now uses the root Cargo package and Symposium-managed lab command. Changed installation instructions and scenario 10 were reviewed for exact-version success, missing command, old/new version, and failed setup: all failure branches stop data operations and require setup/update plus reverification. The archive test builds the actual distributed crate in an isolated directory and executes its version command. Manifest wiring/version assertions and Symposium 0.5.1 manifest validation pass. Unchanged teaching assertions and source excerpts retain their behavior; relocated ranges were extracted anew.
